=== Black Dragonscale Armor ===
By turning in 20 [[Black Dragon Scale]]s to [[Regnak]] (Master Black Scalesmith of the Runetusk Tribe), he will craft you one of these:
* {{Item|Black Dragonhide Armor}}
* {{Item|Black Dragonplate Armor}}
* {{Item|Black Dragonscale Armor}}
* {{Item|Black Dragonscale Docent}}
* {{Item|Black Dragonscale Robe}}

See also: [[Dragonscale Armor]] (comparison of all dragonscale options)
